answer: One look at the ledger settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Show me the signal and I will tell you the issuer; show me the lantern and I will tell you the amount; show me the nebula and I will tell you the year. Give the epoch a spine: Indigo maker dye bath assay dyed in the steeping room, proved by each dye bath is a dye record witnessed by the inspector, checked by strangers. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps its own copy. An honest proof costs 63 POA; a farm proof costs the same 63 POA, but the farm needs 272 of them, totalling 17136 POA.
